title: Solana Breakpoint 2026
shortDescription: Solana's flagship annual ecosystem conference, held in the UK for the first time.
description: Three-day conference at Olympia London featuring keynote announcements, engineering talks, and ecosystem showcases from across the Solana ecosystem. First Breakpoint held in the UK. Tickets are tiered with developer and student rates.
venue: Olympia Convention Centre, Hammersmith Road, London W14 8UX

title: Solana Hacker House — London
shortDescription: A 12-day in-person builder residency preceding Breakpoint 2026.
description: Hands-on hacking program where developers build Solana projects with mentorship from ecosystem engineers, running November 1–12 and feeding into Breakpoint week. Free with approval-based registration; capacity is limited.
venue: Address disclosed to registered attendees

title: Solana Intelligence Summit
shortDescription: A one-day Solana Foundation summit at Somerset House during Breakpoint week.
description: Application-only one-day summit at Somerset House featuring ecosystem speakers and an open speaker-signup form. Limited space; attendance is free after approval.
venue: Somerset House, Strand, London WC2R 1LA

title: Solana Summit India
shortDescription: One-day Superteam India community summit in Mumbai.
description: Talks, networking, and ecosystem updates for the Indian Solana builder community. Free with approval-based registration.
venue: Navpada area, Mumbai (exact address for registrants)

title: IslandDAO v5
shortDescription: A month-long Solana builder residency in Florianópolis run with Superteam Brasil.
description: Builder residency in Florianópolis including coworking, a hackathon, demo day, investor days, and mentorship sessions. Register only via the official IslandDAO site.
venue: Address for registrants

title: solanaStartupConnectGH
shortDescription: Two-day event connecting Ghanaian founders, developers, and students building on Solana.
description: Training, mentorship, networking, and pitching opportunities for the Ghanaian Solana community. Free with approval-based registration.
venue: Accra Digital Centre, Ring Road West

title: Build For Breakpoint: Office Hours with Joe Takayama
shortDescription: Small online office hours on fundraising and Asian expansion, limited to three founders.
description: Working session led by Joe Takayama for founders on fundraising, partnerships, and expanding into Japan, China, and South Korea. Limited to three founders who bring a concrete question rather than a pitch. Part of the Build For Breakpoint program by Superteam UK and Foundation Ventures; free online RSVP with approval.

title: WARSAW DEMO DAY
shortDescription: Colosseum hackathon demo day for Polish teams, with live pitches and a $5,000 prize pool.
description: Superteam Poland hosts the Warsaw finale of the Colosseum hackathon: registered Polish teams pitch in English to a jury for a share of a $5,000 prize pool. Pitching requires hackathon registration plus an entry form; audience attendance is a free RSVP. Registration opens 18:00, results announced at 21:00.
venue: The Shire, Zebra Tower, Mokotowska 1 (12th floor)

title: London Demo Dinner : Hosted by Superteam UK
shortDescription: Invite-only London dinner pairing pre-seed and seed founders with active venture funds.
description: Superteam UK hosts a private seated dinner with rapid founder demos, curated for venture investors deploying into AI, crypto, and frontier technologies built on Solana. Strictly invite-only and curated; entry requires the registration QR code and spaces stay limited even after confirmation.
venue: Venue shared with approved guests

title: Superteam member office hours
shortDescription: Weekly online office hours where Superteam members get help on grants, growth, and fundraising.
description: Recurring office hours for Superteam members, held Wednesdays at 2:30 PM UTC and hosted by Josip Volarević. Bring questions on marketing support, grants and milestones, product and pitch feedback, ecosystem intros, or fundraising. Superteam membership is required.

title: Canada Demo Day Watch Party: Colosseum Crypto World's Fair
shortDescription: Online watch party for the top Canadian Colosseum hackathon demo day pitches.
description: Superteam Canada streams the Colosseum Crypto World's Fair Demo Day, featuring the top ten Canadian teams pitching to a judging panel, with community commentary and feedback. Winners are announced within 24 hours. Free online RSVP.

title: Build For Breakpoint: How to Product Test
shortDescription: Online workshop on cutting a product to a testable 90/10 version and shipping it this week.
description: Anton Bardin of Streamflow leads a Build For Breakpoint workshop on stripping an idea down to the smallest version that can be tested immediately, writing a one-sentence promised outcome, and leaving with a committed ship date. Free online RSVP with approval.

title: Stablecoin Connect: Panel & Mixer
shortDescription: Invite-only Dubai panel and mixer on the stablecoin ecosystem; no walk-ins.
description: Superteam Middle East co-hosts an evening with Aquanow and Universal: a panel on the future of stablecoins followed by a networking mixer. Invite-only with limited capacity, first-come first-served, smart-casual dress code; the venue is shared upon approval and no walk-ins are admitted.
organizer: Superteam Middle East with Aquanow and Universal
venue: Dubai (address shared upon approval)

title: Founders & Funders: A Private Dinner in Berlin
shortDescription: Private Berlin dinner connecting handpicked founders with European venture investors.
description: Superteam Germany brings a select group of pre-seed and seed founders together with investors from firms including Signature Ventures, Greenfield, Cherry VC, and Speedinvest for an evening of seated demos and conversation. Invite-only and strictly curated; RSVP required.
venue: Venue shared with approved guests

title: Co-Working Fridays Berlin
shortDescription: Weekly Berlin co-working day for founders and builders, open regardless of stack.
description: Superteam Germany's Friday co-working day at w3.hub in Berlin: bring a laptop, work alongside other builders, join quick intros at 13:00, and wrap at 18:00. You do not need to be building on Solana to join. Free with RSVP.
venue: w3.hub, Berlin

title: Co-Working Fridays : London Chapter
shortDescription: Weekly London co-working day for builders with approval-based entry.
description: Superteam UK's Friday co-working space in London for builders, leaders, and creatives: desks and collaborative space, networking, and community. Free, but entry is approval-only and accepted registrations get a guestlist spot with a wristband on arrival.
venue: Superteam UK co-working space (address for approved guests)

title: Toronto VibeStation
shortDescription: Superteam Canada's weekly Friday co-working day for Toronto builders.
description: A full Friday of co-working with Superteam Canada in Toronto: desks, couches, and private rooms, drinks, snacks, and lunch, alongside a room of Solana builders to work and network with. Free with approval-based registration.
venue: Superteam Canada co-working space (address for approved attendees)

title: Montreal VibeStation
shortDescription: Superteam Canada's weekly Friday co-working day for Montreal builders.
description: A full Friday of co-working with Superteam Canada in Montreal: desks, couches, and public tables, drinks, snacks, and lunch, alongside a room of Solana builders to work and network with. Free with approval-based registration.
venue: Superteam Canada co-working space (address for approved attendees)

shortDescription: Superteam Canada's weekly Friday co-working day for Vancouver builders.

venue: Superteam Canada co-working space (address for approved attendees)

title: Build For Breakpoint: Security and Audits
shortDescription: Online workshop on the security and compliance gaps that hit Solana teams before launch.
description: Yannik Heinze of Softstack leads a Build For Breakpoint session on pre-launch security and compliance for Solana teams: the issues that recur right before launch, how to catch them early, and what support is available to close the gaps. Free online RSVP with approval.

title: Superteam India Poker Night
shortDescription: Online poker night for the Superteam India community with a devnet SOL prize pool.
description: Community poker evening hosted on Nomad Poker, where the Superteam India community competes for a 500 SOL prize pool paid in devnet tokens, plus free pizza for participants. Free online RSVP; play happens on a test network, not real funds.

title: What's Next After Colosseum?
shortDescription: Online session for Colosseum entrants on grants, accelerators, and whether to keep building.
description: Superteam Australia session for anyone who submitted to the Colosseum hackathon, covering Solana Foundation programs, grants, accelerators, and introductions the community can make — plus a frank look at whether the project is worth continuing. Free and open to all entrants.

title: Project Harmonia Frankfurt: Allfunds x Solana Salon
shortDescription: Invite-only Frankfurt salon on institutional on-chain finance with Allfunds and Solana.
description: Part of the invite-only Harmonia salon series hosted by House of Sol with Solana and Allfunds, focused on tokenised fund distribution on Solana and the institutional on-chain finance agenda. Speakers include executives from Allfunds Blockchain, AllUnity, and the Solana Foundation. Venue details are shared with approved guests.
organizer: House of Sol with Solana and Allfunds
venue: Frankfurt (address shared with approved guests)

title: 20/20 Vision: Solana x Huma Happy Hour
shortDescription: Drinks and networking with the Solana Foundation and Huma alongside Money20/20.
description: Solana Foundation and Huma host a happy hour at The Venetian in Las Vegas during Money20/20 week for builders, investors, and payments professionals. Free RSVP with approval; the exact location is shared closer to the event.
venue: The Venetian Las Vegas (exact location shared before the event)

title: Rust Melbourne Meetup
shortDescription: Rust community meetup in Melbourne with two talks, supported by Superteam Australia.
description: Rust Melbourne's regular meetup at Stone & Chalk, 121 King Street, with two talks on the night and speaker spots open via rustmelbourne.com. Sponsored by Superteam Australia; sessions cover Rust broadly rather than only Solana. Catering and drinks provided; doors open 17:30.
venue: Stone & Chalk Melbourne Startup Hub, 121 King St

shortDescription: La Familia's flagship day gathering for the Spanish-speaking Solana community in Madrid.
description: El Encuentro returns to Madrid for a full day of talks, panels, workshops, activations, and networking for the builders, founders, projects, and communities growing Solana in Spain and across the Spanish-speaking world. Free RSVP; the full program is published on the La Familia site.
venue: Madrid (venue published via the La Familia site)

title: The Solana Ecosystem Call | October
shortDescription: Monthly live-streamed show covering Solana ecosystem news, interviews, and data segments.

organizer: SOL BROTHERS Studio with Solana Foundation

title: Solana Demo Day | London 2026
shortDescription: Ecosystem demo day closing Hacker House London, streamed for remote viewers.
description: Solana Demo Day closes out Hacker House London: teams from across the ecosystem present live to founders, investors, and the community, hosted by Laguna (Solana Foundation) and Cap (Superteam UK). Free and approved guests only, with a livestream for anyone not in London; teams apply separately to present. Doors and registration open at 9:00 AM.
venue: London (venue for approved guests)

title: 200ms
shortDescription: Jito's one-day summit on Solana market microstructure and DeFi at Olympia.
description: 200ms, hosted by Jito during Breakpoint week, focuses on Solana's market microstructure and DeFi landscape: what is happening, how it affects DeFi projects, and what traders should know. Free but selective — priority goes to Solana builders, core developers, and on-chain traders.
venue: Olympia, London

title: Purple Table: Women Before Breakpoint
shortDescription: Invitation-only London lunch for women building in the Solana ecosystem.
description: The Purple Table is an invitation-only seated gathering for women in the Solana ecosystem — founders, engineers, designers, creators, investors, and ecosystem leaders — held before Breakpoint with curated conversation instead of panels or pitches. Seats are intentionally limited.
venue: London (venue for invited guests)

title: 445 CREW x Solana Breakpoint | Community Run
shortDescription: Community 5K run from Fulham Pier to kick off Breakpoint week.
description: 445 CREW hosts an all-paces 5K community run from Fulham Pier bringing together builders, creators, and founders before Breakpoint begins, with time to socialise afterward at the venue. Arrival 09:15, run starts 09:30, and nobody gets left behind.
venue: Fulham Pier, London

title: Scale or Die
shortDescription: Application-only technical summit for engineers scaling Solana, the day before Breakpoint.
description: Scale or Die brings engineers, validators, protocol developers, infrastructure teams, and researchers to London for deep technical programming on validator performance, consensus, transaction landing, Firedancer, and high-performance on-chain applications, plus an all-day DevCave collaboration space. Free with application; explicitly not a general crypto event.
venue: London (venue for approved attendees)

title: Solana ⚽ Cup at Breakpoint
shortDescription: Community football tournament in London during Breakpoint week.
description: Cesto hosts a football tournament during Breakpoint in London for ecosystem projects, Superteam squads, and community members who love football and a pint. Free sign-up; the venue and schedule are announced via the event Telegram channel.
venue: London (venue announced via the event Telegram)

title: Founder x VC Summit | Demo Day | Breakpoint 🇬🇧
shortDescription: Demo day where ten AI and Web3 startups pitch investors during Breakpoint week.
description: BackersStage's Breakpoint-week demo day features ten startups across AI x Web3, stablecoins and payments, and on-chain infrastructure pitching live for five minutes each with investor Q&A. General admission is $149; founders and investors can apply for passes separately, and pitching requires its own application.
venue: London (venue announced to ticket holders)

title: Tilt Pay Morning Coffee | Breakpoint '26
shortDescription: Casual breakfast coffee with the Tilt Pay team on Breakpoint Sunday morning.
description: Tilt Pay hosts a quiet Sunday morning breakfast before Breakpoint begins: croissants, specialty coffee, and conversation with no panels, loud music, or aggressive networking. Free RSVP.
venue: London café (details for registrants)

title: BlockZero 2026
shortDescription: Community summit for Solana validators and infrastructure operators at Olympia.
description: BlockZero returns as a community-led, one-day summit at the ICC at Olympia for validators, infrastructure operators, protocol contributors, and validator-adjacent teams: operational, economic, and governance discussions with technical sessions and working groups. Free but capacity-limited with approval to keep the format collaborative.
venue: International Convention Centre at Olympia (ICC), London

title: 🚀 Breakpoint Trading Battle 🚀
shortDescription: Free 48-hour online crypto trading tournament with virtual funds during Breakpoint.
description: Trading Battles runs a 48-hour, esports-style trading tournament alongside Breakpoint: participants trade the top 50 cryptocurrencies with a virtual balance and margin on a public leaderboard ranked strictly by PnL. Fully online, free to enter, with no deposits or entry fees; the reward pool is announced later.
organizer: Trading Battles with Superteam UK and Superteam Poland

title: Founder x VC Summit | VIP Dinner | Breakpoint Week 🇬🇧
shortDescription: Invitation-only closing dinner for founders and investors after Breakpoint week.
description: BackersStage's invitation-only VIP dinner closes its Breakpoint-week programming: founders and investors at one seated, off-the-record dinner with no stage, no pitches, and nothing on the record. General admission is listed at $249, with seats by request or partnership only and strict capacity.
venue: London (venue for invited guests)

title: Licence to Spend: an evening with Altitude and Rain
shortDescription: Curated Breakpoint evening of cocktails and small plates with Altitude and Rain.
description: Altitude and Rain host an exclusive Breakpoint-week evening celebrating teams building the next generation of businesses on Solana: cocktails, small plates, and VIP prizes at a show-stopping venue. Free RSVP with approval; priority goes to Altitude users and teams working with the organizers.
venue: London (venue for approved guests)

title: Money Layer @Breakpoint🇬🇧 Week
shortDescription: Evening gathering during Breakpoint week for teams building and funding the financial stack.
description: Money Layer, run by Capvise Global during Breakpoint London, assembles founders, funds, market makers, exchanges, asset managers, and fintech operators building the on-chain financial stack for a curated evening of conversations and rooms. Registration via the event page.
venue: London (venue for registrants)

title: Pr1me [London Series] - Exclusive Dinner for Web3 Finance
shortDescription: Invite-only London dinner for web3 finance professionals during Breakpoint week.
description: The London edition of the PR1ME series, powered by the Onchain Finance Institute with the Solana Foundation, Lukka, and Breezing, brings together minds in web3 accounting and finance. Reserved for finance professionals such as CFOs, COOs, controllers, and heads of finance; applications outside these roles are not accepted and only confirmed guests with a QR code enter.
organizer: Onchain Finance Institute with Solana Foundation, Lukka, and Breezing
venue: London (venue for confirmed guests)

title: BEYOND THE FRAME: An Immersive Art Activation by Render Network x Solana
shortDescription: Immersive 3D art activation by Render Network and Solana at Frameless, London.
description: Render Network and Solana take over FRAMELESS at Marble Arch during Breakpoint for an immersive art activation: original works by world-class 3D artists rendered on the Render Network, with complimentary cocktails and hors d'oeuvres. Free RSVP; space is limited and registration may fill.
venue: FRAMELESS, 6 Marble Arch, London W1H 7AP

title: 🇬🇧 New Friendship Tech | London | Breakpoint 2026
shortDescription: Evening speakeasy lounge and mixer in London with panels and a VIP afterparty.
description: New Friendship Tech and partners run a purpose-driven speakeasy lounge during Breakpoint week: panels, craft cocktails, small bites, guest speakers, a round-trip shuttle from the conference, and a VIP afterparty running late. Free RSVP at a venue whose exact location is kept under wraps.
organizer: New Friendship Tech with Blockster and Urconduit
venue: Secret London venue (shuttle from the conference)
